ING-037-car-rain-windshield.why: Correct black closure (one belt, single central plate, gold diamond lock, D-staples, toggle below), heavy glossy creases, believable rainy-car light with wet umbrella; v1/v2 also pass but v3 is the most lived-in frame.

ING-041-home-dining-table.why: Clearly wider than tall, crisp single central plate with diamond lock plus toggle and both staples, braided top edge, rich creasing, natural dining-room window light; v1 reads taller, v3 bag smaller and lock slightly mushy.

ING-046-home-window-sill.why: Cleanest diamond turn lock of the three, correct single-plate layout, sun-raked crease texture, believable brownstone window; v1 and v3 locks read slightly mutated/folded.

ING-047-home-bathroom-vanity.why: Single central plate with diamond, toggle below, gold-only hardware, heavy antiqued creases on dark marble with natural warm light; v1 flatter light with squared-off staples, v3 slightly taller proportion.

ING-051-home-staircase-newel.why: Correct closure clearly readable, superb crease texture, believable hallway lamp light and worn stair paint; v1 too shadowed with tiny lock, v3 has a confusing cane behind the handles and slightly printed-looking grain.

ING-055-open-carseat-45.why: Open mouth with unlined caramel suede interior, ONE central plate on the panel with post and toggle, straps loose; bottle/book marks are illegible smudge, not readable text. v1 has clasp plates fused onto the rolled handles; v2 grows a long shoulder strap plus rim D-rings and stud row.

ING-059-open-bed-45.why: Coherent open closure: sangle plate on the flat belt, square post base on the panel, gold strap tips, two handles, unlined tan suede interior, natural bedroom light. v2 invents front studs, rim D-rings and an interior pocket; v3 fuses a clasp plate onto a handle.

ING-063-pack-waterbottle.why: All three variants duplicate the single clasp plate: v1 carries two full sangle plates plus a separate square fitting, v2 three plates, v3 a crest fitting plus three plates in an X-drape - invented hardware beyond the gallery layout on every option.

ING-067-pack-glasses-case.why: Single plate with turn lock standing open, belt keeper and toggle only - matches the gallery census; natural hand with rings, unlined tan interior, marble kitchen photoreal. v1 and v2 both scatter 2-3 extra clasp plates across the front.
